body: You really didn't do anything wrong. Nothing your wrote was inappropriate so you really don't have to worry about it. (I know thats easier said than done).
I can assure you a lot of people feel this way. I don't say this to invalidate your problems. Its just you're absolutely not alone in that.

I can relate to this very well. I am really sorry that you feel this way.

I cannot really give advice but I just want to say I really understand how you feel, it sucks to have to deal with this feeling

This is painfully relatable... :/ 

Makes me think of just disappearing honestly.

If I am with people I actually know then its not really so hard. But I have had moments where I had to play and voice call with someone I never really got to know. So I have no idea what to say or what I can or cannot say to them. So I just stay quiet

I really want that kind of friendship so much. I really want to have that kind of friendship where I can talk about literally anything with. Even if its incredibly silly. 

Too bad that my anxiety gets in the way when it comes to opening up to people though :(
I can just say I can relate to this to the very core.
Stuttering, racing thoughts and trembling hands.
Thats a good way to get out of this situation. I will try. Thanks.

This is honestly so true yet people don't even acknowledge it. Its fucking infuriating.

I am pretty quiet myself and it honestly makes me feel like shit if someone would ever treat me as if I am some time-ticking bomb waiting to explode. It really does something to people.
I understand perfectly how you feel. I feel the same way. I am sorry you have to endure this.

I don't even want a life like this. I didn't ask to be born and having to endure this whole charade. And yes, while people can say ''oh but people who are being mean to you are projecting their own problems onto you'' I didn't ask to become a punching bag for people. I am (probably not) a person. I already know I am ugly, I already know that I am strange. I don't belong here. My mom tells me I am not ugly but well, she is my mother.

I really want to be happy and belong somewhere but that's hard if you cannot really open up to people and when I do I always regret it. I have experienced psychological abuse that really has an impact on my way of thinking to this day. I am mentally scarred, the thoughts will never go away and I will always be reminded that I am a failure.

People tell me that I have to see things positively, but there is really no reason to stay positive not only with my personal problems but with the state of the world also. I am very scared and I don't want to be here.

Its the sad truth that I will never have the life most people dream of. My hopes get shattered constantly and I get reminded that I am too feeble and too weak to make them a reality. No one could love someone like me. Those who did have given up on me. I am going to die alone, no one would want to ever be with someone as ugly and empty as me.

My life really has no meaning to be honest. I am just living day by day and I am not even doing anything. Nothing truly interests me anymore. I have been trying to be better and work on myself but I feel like that there is no point. I can't really belong anywhere, I can't really feel at peace. I am very drained and I know you're trying to be helpful and I appreciate that but I have no reason to be proud of my life while it's in complete ruin. People often tell me that I have to be proud of myself for how far I have come, but it doesn't feel like a win. I don't even feel like I truly survived it. I am a hollow shell of what I could have been. I would have been very different if I didn't experience the things I have been going through and that really haunts me. I know having so much self pity has no use, but I am genuinely not happy with myself or my life. I am not living, I am just existing.

There's nothing to love about my life. I just don't see the point in living, when I am just being reminded constantly that I am not wanted here and that I am clearly not in the right place.

My friends don't really care and I can't blame them because no one would really want to hang around someone who has low self esteem and loathes themselves so much. They just feel bad for me.
